rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=200, recon_eta=80.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=True, recon_dcstep_every=12, recon_dcstep_n_cg=10, recon_dcstep_warmup=25, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=20, train_n=0, seed=42, rationale=iter-10 (toward 20): recon_eta 40->80 at dcstep_every=12 optimum.
